info.name: AchomVictoria_Phase1 - schedule-service & payment-service
info.description:
LearningHub Phase 1 tests: schedule-service (8103), payment-service (8107), config-service (8888) and the enrollment dev stub (8104).

Caller identity in Phase 1 comes from the X-User / X-Role headers; requests without them act as the student 'sstudent'.

Run against a FRESH dev database (docker compose down -v, then docker compose up --build) so the seed ids and unpaid invoices match. Set 'profile' to prod and run folder 0 to check the prod profile (folders 1-6 need dev seed data).

exec: // Sets {{wednesday}} and {{sunday}} to this week's dates (yyyy-mm-dd), so the
// schedule tests always hit a class day and a no-class day.
const iso = d => new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

pm.test("V1 schema applied", () => { const m = Object.values(pm.response.json().contexts).flatMap(ctx => Object.values(ctx.flywayBeans || {})).flatMap(b => b.migrations); pm.expect(m.some(x => x.version === "1" && x.state === "SUCCESS")).to.be.true; });
pm.test("student labels", () => pm.expect(stats.map(s => s.label)).to.eql(["Total Paid","Upcoming Payment","Pending","Amount Due"]));
if (rows.length) pm.test("first row is Pay Now", () => pm.expect(rows[0].action).to.eql("Pay Now"));
pm.test("sorted by due date", () => { const d = rows.map(r => new Date(r.dueDate)); for (let i = 1; i < d.length; i++) pm.expect(d[i] >= d[i-1]).to.be.true; });
pm.test("no username for a student", () => rows.forEach(r => pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property("username")));
pm.test("exactly one default card", () => pm.expect(cards.filter(c => c.isDefault)).to.have.lengthOf(1));
pm.test("only last 4 digits stored", () => cards.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.last4).to.match(/^\d{4}$/)));
pm.test("one $320 line per course", () => { pm.expect(inv.breakdown).to.have.lengthOf(5); inv.breakdown.forEach(l => pm.expect(l.amount).to.eql("$320.00")); });
